headline.en: UNI bounces 6.91% weekly but net inflation of +1.83%/yr and thin volume keep the structural bear case intact.
headline.zh: UNI 周涨 6.91%,但年净通胀 +1.83% 叠加成交萎缩,结构性看空逻辑未被打破。

keyChanges.en: Price +6.91% weekly to $4.22 on just $5.86M 24h volume — 0.22% turnover on a $2.64B cap says short-covering, not accumulation.
keyChanges.zh: 价格周涨 6.91% 至 $4.22,但 24h 成交仅 $5.86M,对应 $2.64B 市值换手率 0.22%,更像空头回补而非建仓。

keyChanges.en: Annualized revenue $91.39M funds $15.54M buyback = 3.68M UNI burned vs 20M emission, net +1.83% dilution — burn math still cosmetic.
keyChanges.zh: 年化协议收入 $91.39M 支撑 $15.54M buyback(回购),年销毁 3.68M UNI 对比 20M UNI 排放,净通胀 +1.83%,销毁叙事仍是化妆品。

keyChanges.en: Governance forum shows three concurrent protocol-fee-expansion RFCs (v4 fees, Robinhood chain, v4 privacy hooks) — no on-chain vote yet.
keyChanges.zh: 治理论坛同时出现三条协议收费扩展 RFC(v4 protocol fee 激活、Robinhood chain、v4 隐私 hooks),尚无链上投票。

contrarianObservation.en: Three simultaneous fee-expansion RFCs suggest a coordinated DAO push to widen the revenue base. If any escalates to an on-chain vote within weeks, net inflation flips negative without price moving — making $4.22 a cheap call option, not a fair value.
contrarianObservation.zh: 三条协议收费扩展 RFC 同时推进,显示 DAO 正协调扩大收入基数。任一条在数周内升级至链上投票,净通胀无需价格变动即可转负——$4.22 就成了便宜的看涨期权,而非公允价。

watchNext.en: Whether [Temp Check] Activate v4 Protocol Fees escalates to an on-chain governance vote — this is the single biggest revenue lever.
watchNext.zh: [Temp Check] Activate v4 Protocol Fees 是否升级至链上投票——这是最大的收入杠杆。

watchNext.en: Defense of $4.00 support versus a break toward the $3.30-3.50 retail capitulation zone; a break invalidates the accumulation-band read.
watchNext.zh: $4.00 支撑能否守住,还是下破至 $3.30-3.50 散户投降区间;若破位则机构建仓区间的假设失效。

watchNext.en: Any fresh forum thread reviving redirect-buyback-to-stakers (real yield) — dormant since UNIfication burn, but the only clean bull re-rating catalyst.
watchNext.zh: 论坛是否重新出现 buyback 转向 stakers 的 real yield 提案——UNIfication 销毁后已沉寂,但是唯一能带来估值重估的多头催化剂。

fullReasoning.en: UNI printed a soft +6.91% weekly bounce but the structural picture hasn't moved. At $4.22, spot sits 29% below the $5.96 treasury burn mark — the DAO's own implied fair value — and inside the $4-7 institutional accumulation band. That would be constructive if buyback math worked. It doesn't: $91.39M annualized revenue funds a $15.54M buyback, burning ~3.68M UNI against 20M emission, leaving net +1.83% dilution. The burn narrative remains cosmetic. Volume of $5.86M on a $2.64B cap (0.22% turnover) makes this rally look like short-covering, not accumulation. TVL is flat-to-down (-0.47%), Unichain contribution is trivial ($27M), and ETH weakness with 56% BTC dominance strips any beta tailwind. The genuinely new signal is the forum: three concurrent protocol-fee-expansion RFCs (v4 fees activation, Robinhood chain, v4 privacy hooks) suggest a coordinated push to widen the revenue base — the only path that fixes net inflation absent a real-yield vote. But temp check is not on-chain; realistic timeline is months. Positioning is light (OI $21.7M, funding +0.01%, L/S 1.84) so squeezes work either way. Base case: rangebound $3.80-$4.80 over 1-4 weeks. No conviction trade unless v4 fees escalate to on-chain vote or $4.00 support cracks.
fullReasoning.zh: UNI 本周温和反弹 +6.91%,但结构性问题未解。现价 $4.22 较 $5.96 国库销毁隐含价低 29%,处于 $4-7 机构建仓带下沿。表面看是买点,但 buyback 数学不支持:年化协议收入 $91.39M 对应 $15.54M 回购预算,按现价年销毁约 3.68M UNI,面对 20M UNI 年度排放,净通胀仍达 +1.83%,销毁叙事仍是化妆品。24h 成交 $5.86M 对应 $2.64B 市值,换手率 0.22%,这波拉升更像 short covering 而非建仓。TVL 微降 -0.47%,Unichain 贡献仅 $27M 可忽略,ETH 疲弱叠加 BTC dominance 56% 抹掉山寨 beta。真正值得关注的是治理论坛信号:v4 protocol fee 激活、Robinhood chain 扩展、v4 隐私 hooks 三条 RFC 同步推进,显示 DAO 正协调扩大收入基数——这是不依赖 real yield 投票就能解决净通胀的唯一路径,但 temp check 距离链上投票仍需数月。衍生品仓位极轻(OI $21.7M,funding +0.01%,多空账户比 1.84),双向都存在挤压空间。基准情景:未来 1-4 周区间震荡 $3.80-$4.80。除非 v4 fees 升级至链上投票或 $4.00 支撑失守,否则不建议方向性下注。
